title: A bench with --set leaves the main checkout dirty
what: A profile derived by `relay bench --set` is written outside the repository (under ~/.relay/bench/<ts>/ beside its report), or the bench removes it when it ends; `relay improve adopt` of a derived candidate still works.
why: `relay bench --set` writes its derived candidate profile into the main checkout's profiles/candidates/, untracked; guard-main then refuses to remove it, so the owner must delete it by hand and the primary checkout is not clean meanwhile (23 Oct, build-haiku).
failing_case: `relay bench active --set models.build=haiku --tag cheap --runs 1` in /Users/amidman/relay leaves `?? profiles/candidates/build-haiku.toml` in `git status`; `rm` of it is refused by guard-main.
pass_cases: After the same bench, `git status --short` in the main checkout is empty, and the derived profile is found beside the bench report.
